insights.summary: When the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected do not arrive, so callers repeat themselves.
insights.quote: First one, when the AI Voice Agent transfers to a live agent, the details it collected don't arrive on our end. The transfer note comes through empty, so the caller has to repeat their order number and everything else.

insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Procurement is pushing back on paying separately for the add-ons at renewal. PreSense, the QM seats, the AI Voice Agent minutes... they want everything in one bundled price.
